definition: Organic sensation is a bodily feeling caused by a change in the condition of an internal organ or bodily system rather than by an external physical stimulus. In this historical usage, it includes sensations such as muscular feelings, hunger, thirst, nausea, sexual feeling, dizziness, and possibly some breathing or circulation-related feelings like tingling.
